items.title: Telegram chess coach
items.body: Analyse positions, suggest moves, generate puzzles from any variant. Send a photo of a board or paste FEN notation.

items.title: Discord map bot
items.body: Generate hex maps for Nukes, TI4, or Talisman on command. Share seeded maps that anyone can regenerate.

items.title: Slack puzzle-of-the-day
items.body: Post a daily chess puzzle with variant info, hint, and solution behind a spoiler. Track solve rates per channel.

items.title: AI game assistant
items.body: Rules lookup, encounter building, and session management via Claude, GPT, or any MCP client. No custom code needed.

items.title: Procedural world builder
items.body: Combine hex map generation with oracle tables to create entire game worlds. Terrain, settlements, factions, encounters.

items.title: Tournament bracket system
items.body: Manage chess variant tournaments with auto-pairing, result tracking, and live board rendering for spectators.

sections.cta_heading: From zero to calling tools in 30 seconds
sections.cta_body: Connect your MCP client to tools.moddable.games and start making calls. No API key, no signup, no rate limits during beta.
